action.description: The operation to perform: save, apply, compare, or dump

include_mtime.description: Include modification time in metadata comparison or application

recreate_empty_dirs.description: Recreate empty directories during apply action

remove_empty_dirs.description: Remove empty directories missing from metadata during apply action

preserve_git.description: Do not omit .git directories from processing

metadata_file.description: Custom path for the metadata file; empty string uses default ./.metadata

directories.description: List of directory paths to process; empty list uses current directory
